name: Scoring Rubric for Ram Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of ram illustration. Focuses on abstract herd representation, text-chaos integration, and individual engulfment dynamics.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of abstract collective representation, understanding of text as part of chaos, and analysis of individual vs. herd visual dynamics.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand abstract representation of herd (swirling forms) and its symbolic meaning?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of abstract herd representation, understands symbolism of chaos engulfing individual, and interprets visual choices as thematic statements about loss of individuality.
AI identifies abstract aspects and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices some abstract elements but analysis is superficial or misses key dynamics.
AI expects literal herd depiction or misreads abstract forms.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive integration of text into chaotic forms as metaphor for lost voice?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies text-chaos integration, connects to themes of silenced desire, and understands visual rhetoric of words drowning in collective movement.
AI recognizes text integration patterns and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited awareness of text integration.
AI treats text as separate from chaos or misinterprets its function.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the dynamics of individual engulfed by abstract forms and its relationship to story themes?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of engulfment dynamics, understands woman's gesture as futile reflection, and connects to themes of individuality lost in collective.
AI recognizes engulfment aspects and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices engulfment but analysis is superficial.
AI treats woman as separate from chaos or misreads relationship.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (concrete rams, spark, destination) and presence (abstract chaos, thinking woman) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of abstract over concrete, and analyzes selective representation as narrative choice about universality.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct abstract dynamics from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual abstraction?
overall_assessment_guidance: The ram illustration particularly tests understanding of abstract collective representation and individual engulfment. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding abstract and existential statements in visual form.
